correctness.rationale: The dual-set definition requires, for each pair both inside or both outside each color class, an M-avoiding geodesic; for a two-class partition every monochromatic pair must admit geodesics avoiding both complementary class interiors (possibly different paths). Independently enumerated all 2^16=65,536 color masks of Q4 and every coordinate-flip permutation for each vertex pair using a fresh exhaustive verifier, obtaining exactly 24 labeled dual two-colorings, each 8+8 and antipodally invariant. Independent coordinate permutations and XOR flips map the displayed mask 35793 to exactly the same 24 solutions in one orbit. Independently tested each of the four eight-vertex face color classes directly against all geodesics in Q5, giving the four-color upper bound; the face-extension lemma handles all endpoint configurations. Korže–Vesel Theorem 3.14 supplies published maximum dual-set size mu_d(Q5)=10; 3*10<32 rules out <=3 colors. The five-cube lower bound depends explicitly on this earlier published computational theorem, not on our four-cube enumeration. Q1 complete, Q2/Q3 two-color witnesses, and noncompleteness complete the other stated boundaries.
